records.measurement: The source reports isolated cyclized products from both tether variants under their separately optimized conditions. The long-tether substrate gives only trace product under the previously optimized short-tether conditions; changing to dry 1,2-dichloroethane improves its outcome. This is qualitative reaction-context evidence, not a measured local radical rate or a solvent-matched selectivity series.
records.source: main PDF pp2–3; SI PDF pp10,20
